t: Read fragments of Lovewise Catfish's chronicle of the last several years.

Who's coming there? Ah, it's you. It's always a pleasure to see you. Have you brought some stories again? Your adventures inspired me to start writing my book, "The Chronicles of Sarnaut".

I want to write about everything that happened in Sarnaut in the last several years. The world has changed so much, you know that! You are always in the thick of the events.

Here, read a couple of pages.
Of course, I will never get the laurels of Zayan. Ah, I envy elven longevity in the moments like that!

So, did you like it?.. Phew! I was afraid that it came out as boring as the chronicles of the World Mysteries. Or too frivolous, like elven love ballads. But if you say that it's good, there is nothing to worry about!

Now I need to get back to work. Thank you so much! Innumerous pages wouldn't have been written if it were not for you.
Get a Right to Allowance from the Battle Family.

What, itching to give someone a shiner? We get it. We are the same! We used to fight on a battlefield... Brought one down with my sword. Then another... A third one... Well, we took them out, too.
What we're saying is... Do you want to fight and benefit from it? We can help with that! Let me enter your name... How do you spell it?
There you go! Now you're officially a participant of the Battleground! Whenever you want to fight, just search for Skirmishes. If you don't know what Battleground is, we'll tell you later. For now, just listen and don't interrupt.
Every week you will receive a Right to Allowance which you can exchange for gold. You can also earn Signs of Victory in every fight. As soon as you have 100 Signs, use them to combine them into Battleground Emblems. Once you have a lot of them, find me - I'll exchange the emblems for valuable items. Fair terms, don't you agree? We Soldiers of Fortune always enjoy a good fight. And if you can also get something valuable for that, all the better!
This is your Right to Allowance. That's all you're getting. Others need it, too! If you run out, you can get another next week.
Accept pieces of the Battleground Emblems from the Roughneck Family.

So, you're itching to knock somebody's lights out? We get it... We're that way, too! If we had the time, we'd be out on the battlefield, too... Bam, one down! Zip! Another! The third... Well, we catch up to the third one, you betcha!
Anyway, we're trying to make a point here. Want to fight? I mean would you like to fight for a cause? We can help!
Take advantage of the Skirmishes menu and participate in a Battleground. If you don't know what the Battleground is, we'll tell you some other time. Don't interrupt.
We will give you some pieces of the Battleground Emblem. Why just pieces? So you'd still be motivated to join in battle so as to find more pieces. When you've gathered enough pieces and halves to assemble complete Emblems, come to us. We'll trade you valuable equipment for Emblems. Cool, right? We, soldiers of fortune, always ready for a good scrap. All the better if we can earn something valuable in exchange. You can't think of a better pastime!
If you are short of emblems, try visiting the junkmen - they sell the same items for a half price. The downside is that all their stuff is cursed.
Here, take some Emblem pieces. That's all you get! You're not the only one who needs them! If you run out, then you can get new pieces no earlier than next week.
Give to the Keeper of Secrets this canvas belt, so you can get something of better quality.
I have something to reward you. I can see you have a great future, there's this spark in your eyes! This ancient chest contains potent magic. I am sure it will help you in your future deeds.
You don't look happy with your reward. What happened?

Well...
It's not just what we've expected.
It's ok, this example will help me teach you a more important thing.
Take this coupon and exchange it for a free Scroll of Purification in the Boutique.
Exchange the coupon for the Scroll of Purification in the Boutique and use it to remove a curse from the cursed sash. When you complete the task, report to Secret Keeper Lovewise Catfish.

Tensess' Gift which gives us some kind of immortality, didn't come easy to the world.
To override the power of Tep's Pyramid where Tensess Spark can be obtained now, Great Mage of Kania had to fight with Tep himself. Tep failed, however, he managed to do a bad turn to all of us. Many valuable things become cursed. They give no advantages. Quite the contrary! They spoil your abilities, if you put on such cursed item.
So I have a cursed Grubby Belt instead of a good one. Don't worry! We can deal with it all right. The coupon that I've given to you can be exchanged for the Scroll of Purification that will take away the curse. Try and check it.
Did you manage to lift the Curse?

Perfect!
Now you know how to deal with a curse.
All you need is Scroll of Purification. Use it and enjoy your new toy .

Often times when you complete a task you'll learn something new about the world. It could be of incredible importance to the League, or even all of Sarnaut! For that reason I recommend you exercise extreme care and investigate every mystery! You'll be rewarded well for solving them.
If you run into a problem with an investigation, stop and think. Try to remember anything that you may have missed, and try to recall the places in which you may have been too lazy to look. Leave no stone unturned!
I also recommend that you visit the oracle often. Her gift for seeing the future is unique and it would be a terrible waste not to use it. Oh, and of course you must have friends! Ask them - they should be helpful!
What could be more fascinating than researching the world and uncovering all the secrets of the past? Maybe you'll be the one to reveal the most important secret in Sarnaut!

Ah, there we go! Your face seems vaguely familiar...
This is not the first time you've touched the mysteries of the past... And now you just wish to unlock the abilities granted to you for revealing the World Mysteries? Well then, pick the one you're interested in. But remember: only one Mystery is revealed for each Mystery Seal, and no more!
Bring the Fifth Page from the Great Mage's Diary to Goblin Banker in the bank of your faction's capital.
Goblin Banker will certainly be interested in this document.

What unbelievable luck! The Great Mage's Diary has been discovered!
Don't you know who the Great Mage was? It can't be true! Even Goblins know who the Great Mage is! He is a great hero of the past!
In the year 646 of the New Era he solved the mystery of Umoir and helped Skrakan defeat the great demon! See?
For years the diary was thought to be lost. And then this great news arrive! Unfortunately, the adventurers who found it didn't understand the true value of the document. Fools... They thought these papers were just dusty scrolls worth a couple of gold coins... But it is a priceless rarity! Oh, I wish I could have it...
I know that merchants put pages from the diary into Strongboxes of the Counselor. There are plenty of them! Anyone can buy them from the Boutique. I'm sure there's no way to find all the pages.
Oh, I wish someone would bring me just one page! I would be so grateful!
Word of an honest goblin!
What an excellent find! The Great Mage's diary is of national importance. For this information you deserve a hefty reward.
Speak to Prekrasa Horovodova at the Main Square to learn to dance.

Wait a minute! Can you dance? No, I don't mean your one-two-three-step, I mean something more sophisticated. If you cannot, run to the Main Square to take a dancing lesson that Prekrasa Horovodova is giving! Hurry, before she leaves the city!
Don't just stand there, join us! Triple-step and now swing-out!
This is real fun! Now you know how to dance.
Bring 5 Anniversary Copper Coins to Ivan Godovikov.

We are celebrating a great holiday!
It is a one year anniversary of Aidenus issued the order, "Mass Draft of League Militia." Quite a few glorious heroes have appeared in Novograd since then. True gems! Heroes of the people! It was thanks to their achievements that the Empire was weakened and the demon threat repelled. What a wise order it was!
And to celebrate the anniversary, many commemorative coins of different denominations were issued. Copper, silver, gold and platinum.
Obviously, copper coins are the most common of the four, while the platinum are the most rare.
Coins can be found anywhere. You are even sure to get coins as a trophy when battling enemies.
After you acquire a coin, be sure to turn it into "Value," which will transform it from a useless knickknack into a valuable item that you can then use to buy something from me.
For instance, I'll trade you 3 Small Gifts for 5 commemorative copper coins!
I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

Here are the coins... And the gifts!
Happy holiday!
Bring 3 Anniversary Silver Coins to Ivan Godovikov.

For instance, I'll trade you 2 Medium Gifts for 3 commemorative silver coins!
I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

Here are the coins... And the gifts!
Happy holiday!

I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

Here is the coin... And here is your gift!

Receive tickets to Goblinball Championship from Barbell the Referie.

Are you stressed out? Seeing the Purgatory in your nightmares? Cheer up, have a break, go in for sport! There's a nice occasion!
We're in the middle of Sarnaut Cup Goblinball Championship, and we are looking for players! Whole teams of goblinball players! Are you strong enough to stand up for the League? Here are the tickets. Four a week, no more. If it's not enough, use your chance to play practice games. You don't get any rewards or prizes for it, though, but you can play as many games as you need.
Here. Beat the Imperials! I'll cheer for you!
Praise your guild at the three denoted locations and report back to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
It has never been easier! This Pledge gives you an opportunity to glorify your guild all over Novograd. Take these three speeches. You should deliver them at the Elven District, at the Trade District, and in the Gibberling District.
Please note that people listen to Great Heroes more willingly. This means that a Great Hero's speech will bring greater prestige to the guild.
Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.
You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!
Kill 20 Bloody Avengers which invaded the Big Stones Mine and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Bloody Avengers which invaded the Big Stones Mine. Those renegades deserve to die, and there is no better way to glorify your guild than to discipline them.
Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.
Kill 20 demons on Kirah and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Fighting demons is a rightful duty of every citizen. Beat them until they return to the darkness where they belong!
Kill 20 demons on Kirah to complete your pledge.
You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!
Kill 20 Deadmen on the Isle of Revelation and talk to the Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn more Prestige?
I can help you.
Here is the vow you need to take: defeat 20 Deadmen on the Isle of Revelation. Deadmen must be lying in the ground... not wandering the allods!
If you cope can with them, you will have stayed true to your vow.
Go now!
Kill 20 Cultists on Frozen Peak and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Tep Cultists on the Frozen Peak. Those renegades deserve to die, and there is no better way to glorify your guild than to discipline them.
Kill 10 Draconids and 10 Wormfaces at the Frontier and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove loyalty and earn prestige?
I can help you out.
Kill 10 Draconids and 10 Wormfaces at the Frontier. They betrayed us, and it was their death sentence.
Kill 20 pagan aviaks on the Windy Hills and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn Prestige? I can help you with that.
Here is the pledge for you: destroy 20 pagan aviaks that live on the Windy Hills in Irdrich. Those ignorant heretics are incapable of seeing the power of the Light. If their sordid existence in dark superstitions isn't enough to make them accept a life in the Light, maybe the threat of death will!
If you can do it, the pledge will be completed.
Destroy 20 Agitators of the Trinity Church in the Misty Hollow on Irdrich and report to Guild Registrar Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn prestige?
I can help you with this.
Here's the pledge for you: destroy 20 agitators of the Trinity Church, which have been subverting the minds of our potential aviak allies in the Windy Hills. Naive locals are simple and trusting... the agitators will easily subvert them with their stupid ideology. You must save them from the propaganda and put them on the true path to the Light!
Do this to complete your pledge.
Kill 20 Outlaws near Lower City and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Kill 20 outlaws near Lower City to complete your pledge.
Kill 20 Werefoxes near the lake and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Kill 20 werefoxes at Umoir to complete your pledge.
Kill 20 Imperial Sentries or Engineers at Medial Plateau of Kingdom of Elements and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Kill 20 Imperials in Kingdom of Elements.
This will complete your pledge.
Kill 20 Living Ice shards near the Ice Cave on Ferris and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and gain prestige? I can help you with that.
Here is what you need to do: kill 20 Living Ice shards in the icy plains of Ferris. The Surveyors will be very grateful to you!
If you do that, consider your pledge completed.
Kill 20 trolls in the Shore City vicinity on Dane and report to Guild Master Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Here is the pledge: you need to kill 20 dumb trolls on Dane. They are harming the local citizens, and you would really do them a favor if you reduce the population of the beasts.

If you do that, your pledge will be fulfilled.
Kill 20 White Orcs of Siveria and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 White Orcs who inhabit Siveria. These savages are the same breed as the orcs of the Empire, and they are presumably involved in the murder of the members of Ermolai's expedition. Time to show them who rules these lands!
Kill 20 Werebears of the Darkwater and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Werebears of the Darkwater. People also call them Vicious Werebears. These creatures are well-known thieves, they haul into their lairs anything they manage to grab. They even turned to a robbery recently, having plundered a number of our trading caravans. Protect our roads for the glory of your guild!
Kill 20 Kobolds of the Jungle Mine and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Kobolds of the Jungle Mine on Asee-Teph. These cave dwellers occupied the mine preventing us from mining meteorite iron. I guess I don't need to explain how valuable this resource is.
Kill 20 Demonic Cultists of Asee-Teph and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Demonic Cultists on Asee-Teph. This scum must be destroyed on sight! Since you have such a wonderful opportunity, use it to glorify your guild.
Kill 20 Goblin Corsairs at the Takalik Harbor and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Goblin Corsairs landed at the Takalik Harbor on Eljune. Local Free Traders asked for our help. Do it for the glory of your guild!
Kill 20 Tep Cultists on Coba Plateau and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Tep Cultists spotted in Coba Plateau. Fighting them is the duty of every citizen of the League! And if your guild requires more Prestige, this is your chance to help.
Kill 20 Black Dragons on Yazes Shard and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Black Dragons on Yazes Shard. These creatures are dangerous and unpredictable. Great Mages are fighting their leaders, the Great Dragons, for a long time...
Excuse me, I'm running ahead of myself. Aidenus' note says that only the most trusted people can are allowed to Yazes Shard. Make sure you understand how dangerous this mission is before taking this Pledge.
Kill 20 Demons in Gipat Caves and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Demons in Gipat Caves. Every citizen of the League should fight the demons, even on territories beyond our control.
Throw the Challenging Gauntlet on the pavement of Novograd to summon the Shadow Foe, defeat him and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
You can do so by defeating a dangerous enemy that embodies all the bad things that can happen in your guild. Mutiny, fights, intrigues... We are humans after all... Well, not counting for Elves and Gibberlings.
I will give you the Challenging Gauntlet. By throwing it on the Novograd pavement you will shift to another plane of our realm, where you will have to face your Shadow Foe and defeat it.
Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.
You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!
Obtain 50 Marks of Diligence by fighting your enemies and report to Oleg Shpilev.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Then you will have to show your persistence and fervor. You can get a special trophy from the enemies you will face during your journeys, it is called a Mark of Diligence. Collect 50 such Marks and bring them to me. Remember: you will not receive any Marks fighting weaker enemies.
Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.
You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!
Bring a Symbol of the Herald, a Symbol of the Punisher, a Symbol of the Duelist, and a Symbol of the Fervor to Oleg Shpilev.

Complete Pledges to receive special symbols. Keep them in a safe place!

If you manage to complete four Pledges in one day, your efforts for the cause of your guild will be noted! Besides, your services will help your guild reset the Rubies that have already been studied.

Remember, within one day you must complete the following quests: the Pledge of Eulogy, the Pledge of Punishment, the Pledge of Dueling, and the Pledge of Fervor. Bring me a Symbol of the Herald, a Symbol of the Punisher, a Symbol the Duelist, and a Symbol of the Fervor to ensure that your merits will be remembered!
Encouraging the most diligent people makes a good example for the others.
Your diligence will not pass unnoticed! Praised be your guild!

You should know that mere praise won't lead you to success. People judge you by your deeds, and not only on the battle field... Hide your weapon for now. Good deeds await.

More and more soldiers fall in battles every day. Their widows and orphans stay with no support. We seek charity in different guilds to give them home and food. You may volunteer to donate, in order to help the widows and bring glory to your guild.

All you have to do is to buy a Symbol of Mercy from me. I am redirecting all funds to families of the fallen.
Of course, we are creating jobs for all the poor orphans - there are quite good workers among them. It is going to bring profit not only to them, but to the League!
Thank you from all the League! Your contribution is a way more important than you might think. You are welcome to make it again and again.
I will explain you everything you should know about guilds.
Fine, now you know everything. Feel free to join any guild - I'm sure I won't be ashamed for you!
Bring the Replica of a Page of the Carnifex Code to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.
Written in scarlet letters on sheets of ancient parchment. Is this really ink?.. Show this page to Goblin Banker.
The Carnifex Code reveals many dark secrets! Just one page of it will enable you to steal the life force of the enemies that you kill to heal your wounds.
Talk to Marianne de Ardeur to pledge your loyalty to the Church of Light and receive your martyr's blessing.

Greetings! Do you observe the rules of the Church of Light? Do you venerate Tensess' sacrifice? Do you offer up regular prayers?
This is not an idle inquiry. If you consider yourself worthy I will commune with your martyr so that you may receive their blessing. I will not ask for any proof, as I hope that your word is trustworthy enough. Well, what do you say?
Honor the great Sacrifice of Tensess, follow the covenants of the Church of Light, and may the Great Martyrs bless you!
Here is your blessing. May the Light guide you!
Bring the Universal Device to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.
This device looks extremely complicated and rare. Obviously, someone of a very sharp mind has crafted it. It has to be really valuable. Better Talk to Goblin Banker.
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

What’s that? Let me see. A manabike combined with a... bike?!

You are a lucky one. It’s a universal device. I won’t make you coffee, but it can serve as a reactor or as a motor, if you apply it to a ship. What do you need more? Choose!
Bring the Important Gear Part to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.
This device looks extremely complicated and rare. Obviously, someone of a very sharp mind has crafted it. It has to be really valuable. Better Talk to Goblin Banker.
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

What's that? Let me see. A Mana pot combined with a... bike?!

You are a lucky one. It's a universal device. I won't make you coffee, but it can serve as a reactor or as a motor, if you apply it to a ship. What do you need more? Choose!
Bring the Shipyard Certificate to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

The certificate is adorned with dozen stamps, including stamps of the ship-repairing yard and Goblin Banker himself. It reads that the bearer of the document can use the services of most experienced shipwrights, who can turn a frail boat into an unsinkable Corvette. You should show the paper to Goblin Banker!
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

Ah, a certificate! The seal is genuine, and here is my signature. Alright, do you want more cannons, or thicker armor? If you want five cannons on the boards and two at the stern, we can make you a Corvette. If you want it as solid as a rock, we will use reinforced armor. It's up to you!
Bring the Core Storage to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

This thing looks very, very unusual. It seems like voices are whispering inside of it, swords are clanging, and battle spells are echoing dimly... You should show it to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters!
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

What's that? Let me see.

Wow! It is a Core Storage! Aren't you lucky? I will gladly exchange it for any Petrified Core you wish!
Collect 5 Broken Runes and deliver them to the Mysterious Family.
Having regular customers is great! It's nice to have a secure income.
Bring Free Traders' Cannon Plans to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

What's that? Plans of a ship device from the Free Traders. Well... Goblin Banker will surely help.
I'd rather show him these documents.
What do you have for me?

You are lucky!
Soon Free Traders will start selling their astral ship devices in our capital. They have drawn plans as part of their promotion campaign!
You can exchange these plans for a reward!
Bring a Replica of the Free Traders' Cannon Plans to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

What's that? Plans of a ship device from the Free Traders. Well... Goblin Banker will surely help.
I'd rather show him these documents.
What do you have for me?

You are lucky!
Soon Free Traders will start selling their astral ship devices in our capital. They have drawn plans as part of their promotion campaign!
You can exchange these plans for a reward!
Bring Free Traders' Shields Plans to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

What's that? Plans of a ship device from the Free Traders. Well... Goblin Banker will surely help.
I'd rather show him these documents.
What do you have for me?

You are lucky!
Soon Free Traders will start selling their astral ship devices in our capital. They have drawn plans as part of their promotion campaign!
You can exchange these plans for a reward!
Bring a replica of Lesser Scroll of the Commander to Goblin Banker in the bank of your faction's capital.

The scroll is written in an unknown language, but the symbols resemble the ones you noticed inside the Citadel.
It seems this scroll explains new methods of mount training. Interesting... Perhaps Goblin Banker will help you to decipher it!

You can't understand what is written here? Let me have a look!
All right... Overlord, also known as Director, also known as... oh, nevermind... In short, he decided to help all mount owners and teach them special tricks and abilities. Great, isn't it?
Bring a Token of June Dreadnought to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.
Goblin Banker at the bank of your faction's capital will trade this token for something useful.
How can I be of help?
Wow! You are so lucky. I can trade this token for Dreadnought, a powerful combat vehicle!
Bring the Token of Overlord's Throne to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.
Goblin Banker at the bank of your faction's capital will trade this token for something useful.
How can I be of help?
Wow! You are so lucky. I can trade this token for Overlord's Throne, a powerful combat vehicle!
Talk to D2 Golem to receive the Scroll of Fate, then use it to receive bonus Marks of Fate.

Beep! Beep!

Trick the fate!

You have a rare chance to test the Scroll of Fate! It can be used to receive extra marks of Fate!

Come by, don't pass by! Beep!

Congratulations!

You've received the Scroll of Fate and can do anything you want with it!

I recommend reading it. Beep-beep!
Talk to D2 Golem to receive a Potion of Luck.

Beep! Beep!

Come one, come all, don't miss your chance, get your potions here!

For one day only you have the opportunity to sample potions from the Boutique. Take a Potion of Luck, which significantly increases that particular stat. Which makes perfect sense, beep!

Take a look at my wares! Beep. Beep!

Congratulations!

You've received a Potion of Luck and can do anything you want with it!

I recommend drinking it before tackling an important quest. Beep! Beep!
Talk to D2 Golem to receive the Folio of Knowledge, then use it to receive bonus experience.

Beep-beep!
Hurry, hurry and get your experience!
For one day only you have the opportunity to sample the Folio of Knowledge. This magical book doubles all your experience!
Don't delay! Beep-beep!

Congratulations!
You've received the Folio of Knowledge and can do anything you want with it!
I recommend reading it. Beep-beep!
Show the Replica of Lesser Scroll of Sacrament to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.
Hmph... What a peculiar scroll copy. I should bring it to someone who deals a lot with unique wares... to Goblin Banker!
How can I be of help?

It's a copy of one of the lost scrolls!
The one who learns it will receive one extra talent point!
I can help you to understand what is written here.
Bring the Replica of the First Page from the Great Mage's Diary to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

Replica of the First Page from the Great Mage's Diary... Ahem...
I should bring this rarity to Goblin Banker.
And I should free up some space in my bag, as the Goblin might reward me with something valuable... an additional Ruby!

What unbelievable luck! The Great Mage's Diary has been discovered!
Don't you know who the Great Mage was? It can't be true! Even Goblins know who the Great Mage is! He is a great hero of the past!
In the year 646 of the New Era he solved the mystery of Umoir and helped Skrakan defeat the great demon! See?
For years the diary was thought to be lost. And then this great news arrive! Unfortunately, the adventurers who found it didn't understand the true value of the document. Fools... They thought these papers were just dusty scrolls worth a couple of gold coins... But it is a priceless rarity! Oh, I wish I could have it...
I know that merchants put pages from the diary into Strongboxes of the Counselor. There are plenty of them! Anyone can buy them from the Boutique. I'm sure there's no way to find all the pages.
Oh, I wish someone would bring me a page or a copy of it! I would be so grateful!
Word of an honest goblin!

I can't believe my eyes!
It is a copy of a valuable item. Therefore, I give you your reward which you honestly deserved.
Bring the Replica of Common Jeweler Manuscript to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters
Wow! It's a replica of Common Jeweler Manuscript! The manuscript teaches one how to equip a second earring. You'd better bring it to Goblin Banker.

Do you know that the ancient Junes were the greatest masters of gem cutting?
Just so you know - they could cut a full body armor out of a huge diamond! A soldier in such armor was nearly invulnerable.
Good news is that our masters managed to reproduce some of June works!
As you know, a person could only wear a single magic earring earlier, the second caused strong magical resonance, so they suppressed the powers of each other. But the secrets of Junes helped our jewelers to find a way to safely equip the second earring! Isn't it great?
Jewelers' knowledge is kept in the manuscripts that can be found in the Strongboxes sold from the Boutique.
If you manage to find the Common Jeweler Manuscript or its replica, bring it to me, and I'll teach you how to equip a second earring of the uncommon quality!

Now you can equip an additional earring of the uncommon quality.
Congratulations!
Bring Replica of Paragraph from The Study of Perfection to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

It can't be! It's a Replica of Paragraphs from "The Study of Perfection" found by Demon Hunters.
I should bring it to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

Wonderful news, indeed!
Demon Hunters managed to find the Study of Perfection scrolls that were lost after Cataclysm. There are rumors that Junes wrote them and this book was one of the guides studied by the Great Mages in the past. Can you imagine?
Hunters made a lot of copies to give everyone a chance to read it. Look for them in Radiant Strongboxes which can be bought from the Boutique.
If you find a page or its copy, bring it to me, I'll help you to decipher it.
What a find! You'll be glad that you waited to find the entire book. Let me help you decipher these ancient writings. Shall we start?
Bring the replica of the Scroll of the Wrathful Wizard to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

The scroll is densely covered with runes, undecipherable spells, bizarre symbols and strange drawings.
If you look closely, you can recognize an image of some unknown emblem inspiring a sense of danger.
Perhaps, Goblin Banker knows something about this scroll?
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

You managed to find a very rare scroll. These scrolls were written by a very powerful sorcerer in the times of the Conclave. He locked himself in a tower to carry out experiments, trying to combine offensive and protective charms in one amulet. And he succeeded!
Still, his last experiment was unlucky, the magician died and his tower was destroyed. But some of his records resurfaced recently. Now you can trade this scroll for one of the wizard's artifacts. Wear it with pride! It will surely help you in battles.
Take Water of Life and Water of Death from Golem D2.

Beep! Beep!

Hurry! This is your unique chance to reconsider everything!

Only today you can receive Water of Life and Water of Death, that will reset your stats and Talent points!

Do not pass me by!

Congratulations!

You've received Water of Life and Water of Death, and can do anything you want with them!

Think before you act, though.
Collections of various contents are sold here. If you are lucky, you will receive incredible rewards!
Click the star icon next to the item name to add it to your Favorites. This feature is useful if an item is purchased often. Don't forget to visit other sections as well!

Would you like to craft a state-of-art armor or a cloak embroidered in gold? There are items in the Boutique that will make it easier for you.
Moreover, Artisan's Tools will let you acquire additional professions!
Tomes sold here will increase the amount of Experience or Reputation you gain.
Most popular items are shown here, most useful to new adventurers.
Here you can purchase Crystal Chips for upgrading runes which increase your powers.

In this section you will find goods sold at a discount, as well as Strongboxes with unique and very valuable rewards, including manuscripts that increase your powers and grant you new abilities, powerful combat mounts and brand new ship equipment.
Incense grants you the blessing of your Patron and allows to use some special abilities, and drops of mirra shorten the time you spent in the Purgatory.
Do you want to become wiser, quicker or luckier? Drink elixirs and potions to boost your strengths temporarily.

You will find plenty of goods here!
There are scrolls that permanently increase the size of your Quest Log or change your guild emblem.
Crystal pouches sold under the Currency tab allow you to store crystals and transfer them to other players.
Water of Life enables you to reassign your stats, while Water of Death resets your talents and Rubies - this is useful when you decide to change your playstyle.
Scrolls of Purification will cleanse cursed items which you may loot from enemies.
Vote "Against" and Vote "For" Ballots
are used in polls.
Here you can find special offers on item sets. Sets are usually are sold at a discount.

The Boutique sells useful goods, such as elixirs, costumes, mounts, ship equipment and scrolls.
Boutique is divided into sections for easier navigation. What else do you want to know?

This is where beauty and luxury flourish! Smart costumes, carnival masks, elegant wings, stylish wedding gowns and rings are sold here. Amazingly beautiful underwear will become a great present for your beloved one.
Festive fireworks allow setting the right mood, while magical tokens can be used to point out targets in a complex fight.
Astral Megaphones, Magic Ink and Potions of Eloquence are useful for communicating - make sure the whole Sarnaut will hear your words!

In addition to riding mounts and mount feed, here you can buy June Coins, Guiding Shards and tickets to save time in your travels.
Also, there are seals that speed up the construction of your Astral Ship. Coupon Books are used to buy decorations for your ship interior, while Astral Emanations and Astral Coolant will help you in Astral travels.

It is a common issue when an adventurer is carrying a bag full of items. If you are in need of space for trophies, Expansion tokens will allow you to increase the size of your bag or deposit box. In addition, Scroll of Master Goblin will grant you an opportunity to use the bank, mailbox and auction services anywhere in the world!

Every time you open Strongbox bought from the Boutique, you get one Collector's Coin. Beep-beep!
You can trade these coins for something valuable. Beeep!

Collect 700 Shards of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon by completing Anna Kavelina's quests or by opening Boxes of Tears of the Dragon from the Boutique.

Dragons are the Ancients of this world. They call themselves the Keepers of Sarnaut. There is hardly anyone they wouldn't kill willingly: whether it's a demon, or a human, or an animal. Hatred makes their eyes water, and the tears of loathing fall drip drop on the ground...

These tears conceal huge power. We have learned to use them for activating two especially destructive abilities, available to those who have reached a high level. Smaller tears are for sale, larger tears are rewarded for good deeds.

A Frozen Tear of the Dragon is as good as a common tear, perhaps even better - you can never run out of it, no matter how many times you use it. Every good deed you perform will grant you a shard of a Frozen Tear. Collect 700 of them, and I will fuse them into one.A Box of Dragon Tears is sold in the Boutique, if you prefer to obtain them faster!

Here it is. The magnificent Tear of the Dragon that has turned into a perfect, flawless crystal of eternal ice. Keep it safe, hero of Sarnaut. May be, some day you will be lucky enough to learn why they cry...

h: Ask for a Frozen Tear of the Dragon

t: Bring the League State License to Maurice de Ardeur in Novograd Port to receive your Astral ship.

This license grants its holder the right to receive an Astral ship.
Bring it to the constructor Maurice de Ardeur in Novograd Port.
If you happen to find a League State License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away! All League veterans who come back to service are qualified for Astral travels.

In this hard times we need the aid of heroes more than ever! Brave captains will lead their ships through the Astral towards great victories!
We are glad that the veterans like you return to the ranks. The League believes in you!
Use the portable teleporter to the Kingdom of Elements and meet the Collector of Rarities.

Have you ever heard of the Kingdom of Elements?

It's an Astral isle recently discovered by a group of brave travelers who jumped into a previously unknown wormhole. It was a piece of land with some ruins and an old June portal. the travelers managed to activate it.

There was also a volcano in the middle of the isle that started erupting a few months ago and split the land apart. The cataclysm awakened elemental spirits that were sleeping in the depths. Many people were interested in this phenomenon, and soon first explorers, including the Collector of Rarities, an Overlord's servant, arrived to the Kingdom of Elements. Collector of Rarities is looking for those who can help him in his explorations. Remember, this place is dangerous. Aggressive elemental spirits are ready to incinerate, crush, or freeze anyone who steps into their territory. But if you're not afraid, you can gain invaluable experience and a hefty reward for your help in the research.
Did Hugues de Delice send you?

Kingdom of Elements represents a great opportunity for our research. Unfortunately, local dwellers do not feel enthusiastic about it, that's why we need heroes like you to gather materials for research.
Hm... I guess, some Astral perturbance broke the adjustment of the portal. No big deal, I'm going to make some changes, and you'll be able to teleport to Kingdom of Elements again.
h: Portal to the Kingdom of Elements

t:
Oh, come on. Why not? The portal is set up. Everything else is automated.

I can leave a holographic image of me to avoid questions and rush to the Ball.
h: Hello! I believe you can't just drop everything and visit the Great Ball?

t: Bring 22 different class capes to Antoine de Ardeur in Elven District of Novograd.

Have you ever heard of the Ball of Eight Houses, "The Masquerade"? What a spectacular event! Unbridled emotions! Rampant passion! A contest of style, grace and novelty! I'm going to outshine all competitors at the next ball. And I need your help. My assistants are either too stupid, or are spying for other fashion designers. I don't want anyone to know about my venture beforehand, so I need an ally.
I want to organize a costume show! We will play a battle scene between the League and the Empire. The problem is that I need more capes for both sides. Have you seen the Cloak Chests sold in the Boutique? Bring me all 22 capes from the Chests. You can buy them from the Boutique, trade with someone or find them on the auction...
I hope a unique cape sewn by a famous couturier will be a perfect reward for you!
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can easily see which cape I need.
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can see which cape I need. Bring me the one I need right now, I won't accept any other!
Bravo! Bellissimo! Now that we have all capes, my show will astound the Great Houses!
Which reward would you like to receive?
h: Receive reward for "Not a day without a gift" event.

Each hero has their own costume: a warrior will not put on a robe, and a mage will not wear fur skins. But why not? It is the season of experimental fashion! Whatever your path is, you can wear anything. I sell costumes for Anniversary Coins which you can obtain by fighting monsters. When you reach level 10, you can buy costumes for beginners, at level 30 you can get costumes for more experienced heroes, and at the maximum level - costumes for the most influential ones. Those who achieved Greatness have access to the best costumes and accessories. I have clothes for any occasion - in any color and style!

Visit horse breeder Ivan Ovsov at Novograd's gate and ask him about mounts' color patterns.

A letter that arrived at the post office makes mention of horse breeder Ivan Ovsov and his pedigree stallions. This highly respected man may be worth paying a visit - a mighty steed can come in handy when you wander across Sarnaut's vast lands!
Greetings! Want to buy a mighty mount? A fast-legged Steed? Or maybe something more exotic?
Have a look. A good steed will come in handy to anyone!
Talk to Ivan Ovsov, horseman, near Novograd main gates, straddle a horse and bring Aidenus' bag to Vlad Strezhnev, League Defenders Commander in Molotovka.

It's perfect that you are here. I have work for you! Very urgent. You should deliver a very important cargo to Molotovka. And you cannot use portal. Any magical influence will destroy bag's contents.
What is in this bag? I don't know... I know that Aidenus himself has signed it! You should act the following way. You'll take this bag and run to Ivan Ovsov, horseman. He is warned and is waiting for you. Talk to him and he will give special horse for this task. Climb on him and set on travel - to Siveria. There you should find Vlad Strezhnev, League Defenders Commander. You should give this bag to him. You have only one hour for everything. Hurry!
Is everything clear?
Where is Aidenus' courier? Why is he not here?

Finally!
Now my guys shouldn't fear any diseases! Great Aidenus! Savior!
And you too, of course. If not you and that horse... Our healing potion should rotten!
Talk to the Stableman Ivan Ovsov to get the best Combat racing horse.

I know already! You need a combat racer to complete an important government task.
I'll help you.
Talk to me when you will be ready to go.

Saddle up!
Lucky you - got the best horse!
I will give you a scroll allowing to summon it for a short time. Use it, then open your stables for summoning.
Get 20 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

I have great news for you - at last our craftsmen have cracked the Master's technologies. We can now create hard soil out of the Astral!
But only the most distinguished adventurers, those who have earned the title of a Great Hero, will merit an allod of their own - such is Aidenus' decree. The process of creating matter is labor- and time-consuming, and there's one other problem... We can use astralium to create an allod - thanks to you we've mastered the Master's technologies fairly well. But how can we keep the new allod from being absorbed by the Astral? Clearly, you won't find a Great Mage for each new allod! Therefore, meteorite iron is our only option. And as you might've guessed, it doesn't grow on trees.
That's why Aidenus has ordered that meteorite fragments only be given to the heroes who prove themselves in trials. Sets of trials will be changed randomly every day, and you'll get a meteorite fragment for each one. Once you've collected 20 fragments, go see Axiniya Zemlemerova at the dock. She'll get the construction of the new allod started.
Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!
Excellent. Now we have enough meteorite iron to continue construction without running the risk of the Astral absorbing the results of our work!
Check on the allod construction progress, get 30 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

So, let's get started. To begin with, we need to form the core of the future allod. Its heart, so to say! This is a very important process. A slightest mistake can make the whole allod fall apart!

We will need 30 meteorite fragments, which can be obtained by completing Klim Pisarev's quests. Come back as soon as you obtain enough!
Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!
Excellent. Now we have enough meteorite iron to continue construction without running the risk of the Astral absorbing the results of our work!
Check on the allod construction progress, get 40 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

We have completed the most important part. Now let's get down to more trivial tasks, like growing a block of ground on our gorgeous core. It's like building a sculpture at the Astral scale! Alright, I guess you don't need all the details.

We will need 40 meteorite fragments, which can be obtained by completing Klim Pisarev's quests. Come back as soon as you obtain enough!
Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!
Very good! Now we can walk upon this lifeless land, which one day will become the best allod in Sarnaut!
Check on the allod construction progress, get 55 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

It is about time you took part in the construction of your allod. You need to choose what it will look like. Choose wisely!

We will need 55 meteorite fragments, which can be obtained by completing Klim Pisarev's quests. Come back as soon as you obtain enough!
Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!
A good choice! We'll see what we can do. Meanwhile, stay away from the construction site. It's way too dangerous right now.
Accept the work from Dobroslava Arshinova, get 70 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Klim Pisarev and bring them to Axiniya Zemlemerova at the Novograd dock.

Now it is the time for the final stage. Your land has been raw and unstable for too long; it's time for it to become a full-scale allod! Look at what Dobroslava Arshinova has done - she's been working without cease!

We will need 70 meteorite shards, which you can obtain from Klim Pisarev by completing his quests. We will use them to reinforce and decorate the allod.

Come back as soon as you get them, and we will finish the construction!
Just imagine - being the owner of an allod! I don't even have the words to describe what I feel when I see the birth of new land!
Finally, the construction of your allod is complete! You can go to your allod and gaze upon it in all its splendor!
Give Klim Pisarev 320 Emblems of Greatness and speak with Aidenus about achieving greatness.

Now that your veins throb with the blood of dragons, there is no going back. Only onward, to new knowledge and power! Every day, every moment must be spent in self-improvement. To stop is to die. The primordial flame that's in dragon blood will burn you up if it is unable to find outlet in battle or in the attainment of new knowledge.
But if you can tame the dragon flame that now burns within your heart, then you will become one of the League's greatest heroes, and your talents will open new frontiers for you. To subdue the astral and force it back will take more than a gulp of dragon blood, but in your particular field you will become great. Be you a great warrior, paladin or healer, the most important thing is that others see you as a role model, inspiring hope and service to the League. Believe me, this is worth a great deal, even without the Great Mages' talent for limiting the astral to certain spaces and opening portals with the wave of a hand.
However, power goes hand in hand with avarice and pride. So I must test you once again. The test will be difficult, but if you succeed, your efforts will be rewarded a hundredfold. All that I need from you are Emblems of Greatness. You will be assisted in this task by our bookkeeper, Klim Pisarev. Once you've collected the necessary amount, then we can talk about your promotion.
To stand out from the rest, hard work is a must. And you're no exception. But believe me, your efforts will not be in vain.

Well, then... Congratulations, hero! Now you can safely add "Great" to your list of titles!
Now, a bit about controlling dragon flame... Remember how I mentioned self-improvement every day, every hour? Your determination in receiving emblems and that truly superhuman willpower that you employed in order to carry out what was truly a tortuous task are all methods of self-improvement.
Now you must be sure that you are not going to settle for what you've already accomplished. The universe is full of secrets waiting to be discovered!

Hello!
I've been watching you since you managed to survive the disaster and reveal the identity of the mysterious mage. And I'm placing big hopes on you. A great future lies ahead for you, provided you don't stray from the chosen path!
But don't get conceited! The path to glory and success is not easy. You will become a great hero of the League... Or not - that all depends on you. I will follow your every move, celebrate your victories and commiserate with your defeats. And these aren't just empty words! All your deeds, even the minor kind, will be recorded in the League chronicles. The Emblems of Greatness you'll get for truly outstanding achievements will come in handy later, when you become more experienced.
Talk to Klim Pisarev, our accountant, to find out more. Good luck!
Any questions? Feel free to ask them!
I hope you'll heed my words. If you don't stop now, you will become a greatest hero of the League!
Ask Klim Pisarev about exchanging amalgam.

Greetings, hero!
I want to tell you about one of the ways to get Emblems of Greatness.
Talk to me and I'll tell you everything in detail.
Listen to me carefully and focus on what I say.
All clear? Good. Best of luck!
Question Klim Pisarev about the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave.

Greetings, hero!
I want to tell you about one of the ways to get Emblems of Greatness.
Talk to me and I'll tell you everything in detail.
Listen to me carefully and focus on what I say.
All clear? Good. Best of luck!
Question Klim Pisarev about exchanging staples for Emblems of Greatness.

Most likely, you will come across various staples in your travels. They will help you improve your equipment. Bear in mind that you can always exchange extra staples for Emblems of Greatness. I can tell you more if you wish.
Speak with Klim Pisarev, then meet Axiniya Zemlemerova in the Novograd port

Now that you're truly a Great Hero, you can create an allod of your own. This is a great honor that's only granted to the chosen ones!

Go see Axiniya Zemlemerova, the crew supervisor, who will guide through the creation of your allod. She's at the Novograd port. Axiniya will tell you all the particulars of allod creation. And visit the Bookkeeper on your way, he has something to tell you.
Want to learn more about creating new allods? OK, I'll try to tell it to you in brief without going into technical details.
Pay 10 gold to receive the Altruism effect allowing to collect Orbs of Greed safely
Participate in battle on the Arena of Death and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

Have you heard of treasure chests on the Arena of Death? They contain some incredibly valuable items! Of course, you can't just come up to them and grab them. One has to fight the way to the desired reward!

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Participate in battle on the Arena of Death. Yes, it's not going to be easy - you'll have to fight other heroes. But think of the reward!
Participate in Deserted Farm, Witch's Hollow, Training Camp, Battle for Cargallas battleground, or play Goblinball and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Participate in battle in Witch's Hollow, Deserted Farm, Training Camp, or Battle for Cargallas. Ah, or play Goblinball - nothing can be compared to the bloody excitement of that game!

Yes, that's not going to be easy, since other heroes won't let you win just like that. But think of the emotions, of the fervor!
For each trial completed I will reward you with a meteorite fragment that will prevent your allod from dissolving in the Astral.
Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!
Defeat 20 Demons, an Octulhu, or another ancient monster in the Mysterious Astral and return to Klim Pisarev.

The Astral is the natural habitat of Demons, and it makes them especially strong. But we are lucky to have our battle ships!

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Kill twenty Demons in the Mysterious Astral, or destroy an Octulhu or any other ancient monster in the Mysterious Astral. They can be found in the Agitated and Wild sectors.
Destroy the strongest enemy at any island in the Mysterious Astral and report to Klim Pisarev.

I bet you have killed plenty of nasty and incredibly dangerous beasts. And you will kill even more! Remember that each destroyed monster brings you closer to Greatness.

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Go to any of the isles in the Mysterious Astral and destroy the toughest opponent on it.
Complete the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave and report to Klavdia Kalugina.

That cave is a weird place. They say, anything can happen in there.

Here is how you can get yourself a meteorite fragment: complete the trial in Tka-Rik's Cave.
Raise the War Banner and destroy 30 monsters in the Kingdom of Elements, then return to Klim Pisarev.

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Destroy 30 monsters in the Kingdom of Elements. The objective may sound easy, but keep in mind that other players are hoping to get a meteorite fragment, too. To make it even more interesting, raise your War Banner while you fight monsters!
Acquire 15 Desire Incarnates on the Cradle and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.
The Cradle is a mysterious and dangerous place. There the true Greatness is born! Here is a trial for you - acquire 15 Desire Incarnates on the Cradle.
Bring Lodestone from the Boutique to Klim Pisarev.

You must be pretty tired of rambling around Sarnaut and killing enemies in the name of your homeland? My request won't take much of your time. Just bring me one Lodestone from the Boutique, and you will get your meteorite fragment.
For each trial completed I will reward you with a meteorite fragment that will prevent your allod from dissolving in the Astral.
Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!
Earn 1 Silver Anniversary Coin and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

Greatness usually comes along with great riches, obtained with great difficulty. Here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment. Obtain one Silver Anniversary coin. This one's pretty easy, right?
Help Radigost Ploughman fight rodents on Umoir and report to Klim Pisarev.

Have you ever heard of Haregons? You obviously have! You know they are fierce critters. Handling them is a great feat! So, here is a trial for you that will reward you with a meteorite fragment. Help Radigost Ploughman on Umoir!
Complete one of the Pledges to the Guild Master and report to Klim Pisarev.

Never forget those who walk by your side on the way to Greatness! Friends from your guild is the most valuable thing that you have. So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment: complete one of the everyday quests from the Guild Master to help your allies!
Complete one of the daily quests on Irdrich and report to Klim Pisarev.

Though Irdrich is a dead land, Tep's presence has left its marks on it. We need to erase them completely! So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on Irdrich!
Complete one of the daily quests in the Illusory World and report to Klim Pisarev.

The Illusory World, created by Tep, still exists, and it seems like it is here to stay. Its dangers can hardly be called illusory, and its inhabitants live their pretty real lives. A real life means real troubles. And those troubles require real interference. Your interference.

So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest in the Illusory World.
Complete one of the daily quests on the Wandering Island and report to Klim Pisarev.

Your path to Greatness will bring you new allies as well as new enemies. On the Wandering Island, you should never forget who is on your side, and who is not, though it may be difficult. So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on the Wandering Island.
Complete one of the daily quests on the Twilight Isle and report to Klim Pisarev.

Twilight Isle... A place where demons and cultists are hatching their evil plans! We need to do whatever it takes to stop them. Here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on the Twilight Isle.

Keep in mind that you can only complete these quests in a specific time!
Complete one of the daily quests on Kirah and report to Klim Pisarev.

Time has tied into a tight knot on Kirah! Untangling it will take great efforts. One's actions in the past can lead to serious consequences in the present... We need to help our allies. Who knows how this is going to end.

So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - complete any daily quest on Kirah.
Watch the formation of your allod and report to Klim Pisarev.

I heard you were building your own allod? That's amazing! How is it going? You don't know? You better find out! One should keep an eye on those goblins!

Go and check on it right now, alright?

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Watch the formation of your allod! Only those who can fulfill their own will, make their dreams come true, and acquire their own allod deserve the right to be called the Great!
Visit your allod, accept the work from Dobroslava Arshinova, and report to Klim Pisarev.

I heard you allod is almost done. You know that, too? Well, then accept my congratulations! Here is another trial - well, it's not really a trial, more of an invitation - go to your allod and accept the work from Dobroslava. Don't you wonder what it looks like? I will give you a meteorite fragment as an encouraging gift!
